Market today:
The market mood is cautious, driven by rising oil prices and surging bond yields. These inflationary pressures and higher interest rates are a significant headwind for your growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-55.79%) and SPAL (-37.93%) are your biggest concerns; both are leveraged ETFs with deep losses. SMH (-12.71%) and QQQI (-3.4%) are also near their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on oil prices and the 10-year Treasury yield for continued upward pressure. Also, monitor your stops on SMH and QQQI very carefully.

Bottom line:
Rising rates and oil are a double whammy for your leveraged tech book; manage risk aggressively.
plays: Seriously review SOXL and SPAL; their leveraged nature and deep losses are amplified by margin. Consider reducing exposure.
Respect your stops on SMH at 540 and QQQI at 52; these are critical levels to watch today.
Consider XOM long at 159.37-159.12 (stop 158.45) as oil prices surge, offering a potential hedge.
